listWorkers: SELECT id,name,role,phone,permissions,(SELECT warehouses FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=workers.id) AS warehouseScope,(SELECT accounts FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=workers.id) AS accountScope FROM workers ORDER BY name, rowid
findWorker: SELECT id,name,role,phone,permissions,salt,pin_hash,(SELECT warehouses FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=workers.id) AS warehouseScope,(SELECT accounts FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=workers.id) AS accountScope FROM workers WHERE id=@id
workerPinCandidates: SELECT id,name,role,phone,permissions,salt,pin_hash,(SELECT warehouses FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=workers.id) AS warehouseScope,(SELECT accounts FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=workers.id) AS accountScope FROM workers WHERE id<>@except
workerSession: SELECT w.id,w.name,w.role,w.phone,w.permissions,(SELECT warehouses FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=w.id) AS warehouseScope,(SELECT accounts FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=w.id) AS accountScope FROM workers w JOIN worker_sessions s ON s.worker=w.id
openWorkerSession: INSERT INTO worker_sessions SELECT @token,id,@expires FROM workers WHERE id=@id AND pin_hash=@hash
